notes.title: Only 2 Days Until Early Access – Here’s What to Expect!
notes.content:
We’re beyond excited for you to jump in, and today, we want to highlight the key features you’ll get to experience at launch.

[h2]Game Feature List for Early Access[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]4 Classic Fantasy Classes[/b] with innovative [b]Spells & Abilities[/b] that you can unlock and customize
[*] An innovative and unique [b]Combat System[/b] that blends Soulslike Action combat with MMORPG style spells and abilities
[*] Innovative [b]Extraction Gameplay Mode[/b] that evokes the feeling of World PvP from your favorite MMORPG
[*] Level up Character Classes up to [b]Level 20[/b], earning unique Traits along the way
[*] [b]11 Unique Weapon Types[/b] with unique [b]Weapon Abilities[/b] and [b]Traits[/b]
[*] [b]800+ Items[/b] to loot during Adventures or to Craft
[*] [b]Seasonal Campaign[/b], culminating in a quest to defeat the [b]Boss Encounter Morg'thog, The Cruel[/b]
[*] [b]35 Enemy Creatures[/b], including Epic an Special Types with higher difficulty
[*] [b]Play Solo[/b] or up to 2 others in a [b]Squad[/b]
[*] Queue by yourself into [b]Solo Mode[/b] or with Duos or Trios in [b]Mixed Mode[/b]
[*] [b]2 Maps[/b] (1 huge Epic Zone called the [b]Greenwood[/b], and 1 Tutorial Map called [b]Goldbrook[/b] where you can play solo to learn the game in a sandbox environment)
[*] [b]7 Vendors[/b] for players to level up with a rich, MMO-like Crafting System
[*] Build your own [b]Lodge[/b] with [b]6 Furnishings[/b], including:
[list]

[*] [b]The Bed -[/b] Unlocks Rested Experience that builds up while offline
[*] [b]The Cooking Pot -[/b] Cook meals that give you buffs for Adventures
[*] [b]The Storage Chest -[/b] Add new Stash Tabs to your Stash
[*] [b]The Crafting Bench -[/b] Craft unique Class Tools like the War Horn (Warrior) or Poison Dart (Rogue)
[*] [b]The Ossuary -[/b] Sacrifice trophies from fallen enemies to the Blood God, and gain a Reputation buff[/list]
[/list]
Become a Supporter with our [b]Founders Supporter Pack[/b] or [b]God Tier Supporter Pack[/b] to support Notorious Studios in our effort build out the next great RPG franchise. Much more content and features will be patched in for free as we progress through early access, including the following targeted during the next 14 months:
[list]
[*] The [b]Wizard [/b]and [b]Paladin [/b]classes
[*] [b]More Maps[/b], including a night version of Greenwood and Dungeon Crypt map
[*] [b]Goblin Pawn Shop[/b] where you can purchase back the gear you lost during Adventures — for a price!
[*] Cosmetic [b]Character Customization[/b]
[*] [b]Guild Hall[/b] where you can build your own community and unlock new progression features
[*] And much, much more! Check out our [url=https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVLehcEFo=/]Roadmap[/url] for a sneak peek.
[/list]

We are deeply engaged with and have much gratitude to our Community. The more supporter packs Notorious Studios is able to sell, the faster we can ship new features and content into [i]Legacy: Steel & Sorcery.[/i]

Finally, we’re also hosting a live Meet the Devs session tomorrow on our [url=https://discord.gg/playlegacy]Discord[/url]! Chris will be sharing our 3-year journey, future plans for Legacy, and details about our Supporter Packs! Come hang out, ask questions, and be part of the journey!

[b]Wishlist & Follow Notorious Now – The Journey Begins Soon! 🚀[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344320/Legacy_Steel__Sorcery/

notes.title: The Highlights of our AMA!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

Yesterday, our CEO Chris headed over to r/Games for an Ask Me Anything on [i]Legacy: Steel & Sorcery[/i]. While we couldn't post every single questions and answers, we have picked some of the key questions and answers for you, so you can gain a little more insight into the game and what to expect. If you want to read all the questions and answers, with some about the studio and wider franchise, be sure to head on over to the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Games/comments/1iihi54/ama_im_chris_kaleiki_founder_ceo_of_notorious/]Subreddit[/url].

As a reminder, for all things Legacy related – join our [url=https://discord.gg/playlegacy]Discord[/url]!


[b]Q: How will the game ensure new players aren’t overwhelmed by veterans in PvP, and what’s the balance between skill and gear?[/b]
[list]
[*]The game includes hidden paths and traversal mechanics to help players avoid ganking, similar to Tarkov’s "rat" playstyle. Progression is more horizontal, focusing on perks rather than raw power to prevent veteran players from stomping newcomers.
[*]A new tutorial map, Goldbrook, will let players learn the game before entering PvP. The goal is for gear to matter around 60/40 or 70/30 compared to player skill.
[/list]
[b]Q: What’s the most surprising piece of feedback from playtests that led to a change in the game?[/b]
[list]
[*]The biggest surprise was the overwhelming demand for more PvE content, likely due to the studio’s WoW background.
[*]While PvE was always planned, the early demand led to prioritizing a tutorial map, onboarding systems, and a questline to help new players—something most hardcore PvP games don’t typically launch with.
[/list]
[b]Q: Any updates on a console release for Legacy?[/b]
[list]
[*]The plan is to bring Legacy to consoles around its gold master release or shortly after, with a target of early next year, depending on how Early Access performs. The team is also considering which console would be the best fit for launch.
[/list]
[b]Q: Any thoughts on an "Art of Legacy" book to showcase the game's visuals and lore?[/b]
[list]
[*]We will check with the team, but we're sure they'd love the idea and will pass along the suggestion.
[/list]
[b]Q: What lessons from working on World of Warcraft have you applied to Legacy: Steel & Sorcery? Also, what are your thoughts on the current state of WoW?[/b]
[list]
[*]We learned that real player choice in talent systems is often an illusion, as players will always pick the mathematically best option. In Legacy, we've applied this by making gear perks optimal based on conditions rather than just playstyle preference. 
[*]As for WoW, we still consider it a masterpiece and love that Blizzard has added Classic, Hardcore, and Season of Discovery to give players more options while staying true to the original vision.
[/list]
[b]Q: How does marketing budget allocation differ between AAA and indie studios, and how much has your studio spent on marketing?[/b]
[list]
[*]We classify ourselves as more of an AA studio, with a budget between $10M and $20M—far below the ~$200M typical for AAA. Marketing budgets are often equal to or half of a game's development cost, but for our Early Access launch, we're spending under $100K. The industry is shifting in how marketing works, and while streamers are often targeted, data suggests that just making a great game is the best approach for indie and AA titles.
[/list]
[b]Q: How does loot/gear progression work, and can average players get legendaries or uniques? Will low-geared players be wiped by experienced players in legendary gear?[/b]
[list]
[*]Players progress through gear tiers from "Junk" to "Legendary" items, which can be found through RNG or crafted by leveling up vendors and unlocking recipes. New players can obtain legendaries, but gear can be lost upon death. We aim to keep the power differential between low and high-geared players at around 50%, ensuring it's not too extreme, unlike some other PvP RPGs where it's much higher. The game features two maps at EA launch, with more coming soon to expand loot and progression.
[/list]
[b]Q: Can you share details about the upcoming Wizard and Paladin classes and their resource systems?[/b]
[list]
[*]The Wizard will focus on elemental interactions, such as combining Frost and Fire to create Fog, and will have a unique resource system tied to collecting spell scrolls found in the world. They will have the highest number of spells, and exploring the world for new spells will be key. The Paladin is still in paper design, but will have the ability to "Sense Injustice" in the world, identifying assassins and allowing them to seek vengeance. The Paladin will also be able to buff other players, a feature not yet available in the game.
[/list]
[b]Q: As a former backer of Crowfall, what is your game attempting to do differently?[/b]
[list]
[*]We are focusing on the core experience and combat fundamentals first, taking a Crawl/Walk/Run approach rather than trying to do everything at once like Crowfall. While Crowfall had great ideas, its ambition to build an MMO with complex systems and content overwhelmed the project. We’re opting to build over time, focusing on solid foundations before expanding.
[/list]
[b]Q: PvPvE / Extraction / RPG / with MMO elements. Can you explain how these elements reconcile in your game?[/b]
[list]
[*]The game blends Extraction with MMO-like features such as open-world areas, rich crafting, progression, and character customization. While it's focused on PvPvE, there are systems like quests and character creation common in MMOs. We aim to add more MMO features over time, including more PvE experiences and deeper character customization. The blend of "get in, get loot, and leave" with ongoing progression makes it unique. However, I don’t like genres or tags as they don’t fully capture what the game is trying to do.
[/list]
[b]Q: Is this game zone-based or more like The Division with open world public event areas? How does the gameplay structure work?[/b]
[list]
[*] The game features large, sandbox-like zones within session-based maps. It's not a linear level; players can explore and loot freely within the zone. While we do want to eventually explore the idea of moving between zones, the current focus is on massive, single-session maps. Implementing seamless zone transitions is challenging, especially with Unreal, but it's something we might consider later.
[/list]
[b]Q: Is there a connection between the original name "Project Honor" and the mechanic of executing players, or what was the inspiration for the original name?[/b]
[list]
[*] The name "Project Honor" came from an early idea I had around honor-based mechanics, though it wasn't directly tied to executions. The idea was more about giving players the choice in whether to kill others, similar to world PvP zones in MMOs. The game's name evolved to "Legacy," but the concept of honor remains in how players can choose whether to kill or let others live. As for the execution mechanic, it reflects a culture of "honor" and "dishonor" in combat, with plans to let players customize execution animations in the future.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Playtest #5 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Alpha Playtest #5, Adventurers! [/h1]

[h2]TL;DR[/h2]
[list]
[*] This is our final Alpha test before Early Access. In this build we introduce the Warrior's 3rd weapon — the Deathball! Also featured in this build is the Ossuary module for the Lodge, the Wraith and Spider creature as well as many other Elites.
[*] We'd love feedback on all of these additions, as well as specifically the drops and loot from the Elites.
[*] Final content we're working on is the Tutorial Map as well as the Campaign Questline and finalization on the level art and content in Greenwood.
[*] ⚠️ Unfortunately there are still some bugs that will make it into the build since we're in Alpha, please see the [b]Known Issues[/b] section for a list of those.
[/list]
[h2]💖 Featured Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]💀 [b]New Warrior Weapon: Deathball[/b]
[*]🪦 [b]New Lodge Module: Ossuary[/b]
[*]💎 [b]New Gear Mechanic: Gems & Socketing[/b]
[*]🤖 [b]New AI: Elite enemies, Special enemies, Goblin Brawlers, Wraith, and Spiders[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964550/ddb6db3b7b5e091da9006f400ffb1ff31edaa31c.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🗒️ General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the death animation would replay on characters after looking away from them
[/list]
[h2]💞 Matchmaking[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reconnect - Added a re-connection window, allowing players to rejoin in the case of any sudden client crashes or disconnects
[/list]
[h2]⚔️ Combat[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Aim Sensitivity so that it remains consistent when abilities adjust FoV or move the camera
[*] Added a predictive delay to the visual glows on the characters for Evade, Unstoppable, and Unblockable states to increase their accuracy when shown
[*] Increased the rotation rates of players both in and out of combat
[*] Fixed an issue where getting Knocked Down and Rooted at the same time would cause your character to be stuck in the flatten state for the rest of the session
[*] Fixed an issue where players that were Rooted and Stunned at the same time could still fully rotate their character during the stun
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧙‍♀️ Classes[/h2]
[list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved all perk and trait tooltips
[list]
[*] Updated them to use their proper names, such as such as "Air Vault" instead of "Disengage" on Hunter, "Iron Grip" instead of "Chain Pull" on Warrior, and others.[/list][/list]
[h3]Warrior[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced rage generated from taking damage by 30%
[*] Reduced rage generated from attacks by 30% on average
[*] Rampage
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the rage cost would trigger twice if you had 80+ rage[/list]
[*] Enrage - Battle Frenzy
[list]
[*] Renamed Enrage to Battle Frenzy
[*] Rage cost increased to 40, up from 20
[*] Duration increased to 4.5 seconds, up from 2[/list]
[*] Raging Shout
[list]
[*] Removed the stamina drain on incapacitated targets
[*] Enrages the Warrior for 4 seconds after use[/list]
[*] Heroic Leap
[list]
[*] Cooldown reduced to 2 seconds
[*] Snare increased to 70% for 3 seconds
[*] Can go the maximum distance without needing to hold the button
[*] Fixed an issue where the landing spot wasn't always where the circle is
[*] Added VFX to the warrior while leaping[/list]
[*] Charge
[list]
[*] Added a 2 second cooldown after charge completes
[*] Fixed an issue causing damage and hit react to register twice[/list]
[*][b] NEW WEAPON Deathball[/b]
[list]
[*]Deathball is a new Heavy weapon the warrior wields with both hands. It can be thrown to enemies and held in front to block attacks
[*] Normal Attack (LMB): Perform a 3-hit combo.
[*] Charged Attack (Hold LMB): Perform a single, powerful slam.
[*] Block (RMB): Hold to block; Deathball has 6 block power.
[*] Technical Attack (LMB + RMB): Throw the Deathball for ranged damage and guard break.
[*] Flying Doom (Weapon Skill [Q]): Throw the Deathball, dealing damage both on the way out and during its return.
[*] Sprint Attack (Sprint + LMB): Swing the Deathball in a circle, dealing damage in a short range.
[*] Jump Attack (Jump + LMB): Slam the Deathball into the ground, dealing heavy damage nearby.
[*] Evade Attack (Evade + LMB): Dropkick the target, knocking them down.[/list]
[*] Warrior: Mace and Shield
[list]
[*] Quake (Weapon Skill [Q])
[list]
[*] Damage reduced by 35%.[/list]
[*] Technical Attack (LMB + RMB)
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage was hitting twice.[/list]
[*] Craghorn Maul
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Quake would fire in a straight line from the weapon instead of an area around the player.
[/list][/list][/list]
[list]
[*] 2-Handed Axe: Evade Attack
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing damage to register twice.
[/list]
[*] Trait: Vitality
[list]
[*] Moved into the first tier of perks.
[/list]
[*] Trait: Executioner
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing Executioner to fail to apply its effect.
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Hunter[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bramble Trap
[list]
[*] Snare effect increased to 70%.
[*] Now requires an enemy to walk over it to trigger, instead of growing instantly.
[*] Roots all targets for the first 1 second of the trap growing.
[/list]
[*] Spore Bomb
[list]
[*] Poison cloud now deals Nature damage in addition to Poison Buildup.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the cloud to not apply Poison Buildup.
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies were not aggroing when hit with Spore Bomb.
[/list]
[*] Flying Seed
[list]
[*] Reduced the volume of the explosion sound.
[/list]
[*] Shock Beetle
[list]
[*] Now deals damage again.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the damage to sometimes apply multiple times.
[/list]
[*] Sentinel Strike
[list]
[*] Reduced movement speed of the 5 Swiftness instant bird by 30%.
[*] Ensured consistent speed regardless of the cast stage.
[*] Fixed the reticle shrinking animation timing to match the end of the third charge.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing casting while sprinting.
[/list]
[*] Sentinel Cyclone
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the cyclone would not cast after pressing the button a second time to confirm its placement.
[/list]
[*] Sentinel Call
[list]
[*] Improved pathfinding and target selection.
[/list]
[*] Shortbow
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where shooting while mid-air would halt the player’s momentum.
[*] Updated normal attack animations.
[*] Increased homing speed of projectiles for Charged Attack (Hold LMB).
[/list]
[*] Medium Bow
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where reticle animation timing did not match charge time when affected by Swiftness.
[/list]
[*] Elven Dance (Weapon Skill [Q])
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where special arrows were not being consumed properly.
[/list]
[*] Long Bow
[list]
[*] Attempted fixes for issues causing Eagle Stance to be difficult to exit.
[/list]
[*] Trait: Purifying Winds
[list]
[*] Removed from the traits list.
[/list]
[*] Trait: Disengage
[list]
[*] Reduced damage by 75%.
[/list]
[*] Trait: Explosive Seed Shot
[list]
[*] Fixed the trait to apply effects properly.
[/list]
[*] Trait: Monster Slaying
[list]
[*] Fixed the buff to apply correctly.
[/list]
[*] Trait: Thrill of the Hunt
[list]
[*] Now triggers when breaking crates and barrels.
[/list]
[*] Perks
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing Windstrider’s Leafplate Perk and Elven Sylvanborne Tunic Perk to not work.
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Rogue[/h3]
[list]
[*] Class Resource:
[list]
[*] Added Energy as a resource. All abilities now cost Energy and have their cooldowns removed.
[/list]
[*] Abilities
[list]
[*] Claws: 30 Energy, no cooldown.
[*] Phantom Dagger: 60 Energy, no cooldown.
[*] Grapple: 40 Energy, no cooldown.
[*] Visage: 50 Energy, no cooldown.
[*] Stealth Abilities:
[list]
[*] Shroud: 40 Energy, no cooldown.
[*] Phantom Veil: 50 Energy, no cooldown.
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Stealth Mechanics
[list]
[*] Both Rogue weapons can now perform fully charged LMB attacks out of stealth.
[*] The first attack out of Stealth deals 20% bonus damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where homing projectiles continued to track the Rogue in Stealth.
[*] Reduced footstep sound volume during Stealth by 70%.
[*] Footstep visuals follow rules for Stealth and water effects.
[/list]
[*] Invisibility
[list]
[*] Footstep sounds muted entirely during Invisibility.
[*] Visual effects hidden for stealth footsteps.
[/list]
[*] Grapple
[list]
[*] Reduced follow-up attack damage by 30%.
[/list]
[*] Phantom Veil
[list]
[*] Decoy behavior matches the Rogue’s movement (running, sprinting, standing).
[*] Rogue can teleport to the decoy’s location while it’s active.
[/list]
[*] Traits
[list]
[*] Silent Footsteps: Now works correctly; reduces Rogue’s footstep volume by 20%.
[*] Sharpened Blade: Trait now increases damage of the next Charged Attack by 30%.
[*] Disorient: Perk changed to Root targets for 1 second.
[/list]
[*] Fixed rogue weapons occasionally appearing upside down when sheathed.
[/list]

[h3]Priest[/h3]
[list]
[*] Heaven's Fury
[list]
[*] Fixed issues where the ground targeting for Heaven's Fury would appear underneath parts of the terrain.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in the cast animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where the looping sound of the Penitence area persisted for the rest of the session.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cooldown would trigger twice.
[/list]
[*] Heaven's Ward
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Heaven's Ward to not deal any damage.
[/list]
[*] Heaven's Wrath
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Heaven's Wrath to not deal any damage.
[/list]
[*] Holy Nova
[list]
[*] Unstoppable effect now applies at frame 1, down from frame 4.
[/list]
[*] Radiant Dash (Scepter and Staff Dash Attack)
[list]
[*] No longer spawns a Holy Spark when hitting an enemy.
[/list]
[*] Scepter
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where homing projectiles would continue in a straight line instead of following their trajectory if the target was Evading.
[/list]
[*] Holy Staff
[list]
[*] Greater Heal (Weapon Skill [Q])
[list]
[*] Updated the animation to better reflect the maximum 3-second charge time for the skill.
[/list]
[*] Ray of Light (Charged Attack [Hold LMB])
[list]
[*] Doubled the startup animation speed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the beam was pointed in the wrong direction during the first few seconds.
[*] Fixed an issue where hits from the Beam were missing impact effects.
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Sword and Buckler
[list]
[*] Fixed dash equip cancel movement tech issues.
[*] Fixed a bug where the projectile could get stuck and not cast.
[*] Fixed animation jitters during short charges and at the end of the charge.
[/list]
[*] Traits
[list]
[*] Ascend: Fixed an issue causing Ascend to not be usable while sprinting.
[*] Spirit Shell:
[list]
[*] Moved to Tier 1.
[*] Requires level 2 to unlock, costs 1 point to learn.
[*] Allows the Priest's block shield to remain for 20 seconds after holding block for 3 seconds.
[*] No longer triggers a Block Break state when the shield bar is exhausted.
[*] Now has a 15-second cooldown before it can be re-applied.
[/list]
[*] Holy Sparks: Fixed an issue where Holy Sparks would spawn underground in some areas.
[/list]
[*] Perks
[list]
[*] Radiant Leggings: Fixed the Snare effect to apply correctly to all stars.
[*] Blazing Dawn: Reduced spirit cost for Charged Heals now triggers after landing a Charged Heal on one target.
[*] Celestial Dawn: Changed to increase Ray of Light damage by 30%.
[*] Star and Moon S&B: Fixed an issue causing the Snare effect not to apply.
[*] Prayer Card: Spiritual Heal: Reduced Spirit cost to 30 (down from 70).
[*] Spirit Vial: Reduced max charges to 2. Fixed an issue where Spirit Vial could be consumed in the hub.
[/list]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]🌳 World (Greenwood)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added more grass to most of the map.
[*] Introduced a new skybox.
[*] Updated vistas on the edges of the map for improved visuals.
[*] Enhanced water visuals in multiple areas.
[*] Improved network performance of "Grabbable" loot objects.
[*] Adjusted creature spawners to include the new types (see Encounters below).
[*] Added new player footstep VFX for walking on stone, dirt, grass, and water surfaces.
[*] Updated Harvestable Trees:
[list]
[*] Added new models for each type of wood.
[*] The type of wood harvested now matches the tree type and is no longer random.
[*] Tree spawns are now randomized for variety.
[/list]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]⚒️ Items & Progression[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where stash tabs with upgrade containers would sometimes not be sized correctly during account loading, causing items to be lost.
[*] Items that fail to be placed into your inventory while loading your account will now properly go to overflow, giving you a chance to save them in the case of errors.
[*] Fixed an issue where stash tabs with upgrade containers would resize in the middle of an item swap action, causing items to move around unpredictably or be lost.
[*] Stash tab containers can no longer be moved out of their slot or swapped with another stash tab container if the resulting grid size is smaller than what is needed to hold the items in the tab.
[*] You can still swap a stash tab container with a larger one!
[*] Updated the loot in the Treasure rooms.
[*] Adjusted starting items of all characters to include a few class items that are automatically equipped to your class belt and auto-equip potions and bandages to the toolbelt.
[*] Added the missing Split Stack option to the right-click menu on bandages.

[list]

[/list]
[/list]

[list]

notes.title: Legacy: Steel & Sorcery - Alpha Playtest #3 Preview
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

Thanks for participating in Steam's October Next Fest and making Legacy [b]one of the most-played Demos[/b] during the event! The reception was incredible, and we especially appreciate all of you who took the time to submit your feedback to the team.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45046821/4579134c5dcb23b37cd480f1a1bb1cb80f7d1b07.png[/img]

We have a new playtest cooking, which will be available for another week starting on Wednesday, November 13th, at 2 PM PST and ending on Wednesday, November 20th, at 2 PM PST. We hope you can make it! If you signed up for Alpha before, you're already in 🫡.

👉 To sign up, you can do so on our website here: https://playlegacy.gg/signup

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Next Fest Feedback[/h1]
We received some great feedback from you during NextFest through our official form and on the Steam forums. Thank you! Here are some of the results!

[h2]Key Takeaways[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players enjoyed Legacy overall, citing the unique core experience, combat, and class design as some highlights.
[*] More players (33%) "mained" by creating just 1 character class vs 26% who created one of each.
[*] Classes felt fun overall with just a little over a 7% difference in the Most Fun (Warrior) and Least Fun (Priest).
[*] The Least Powerful Class (Rogue) lagged 16% behind the Most Powerful (Priest).
[*] Other than focusing on Fun Gameplay, players cited Listening to the Community and creating Challenges and Rewards as top priorities for Legacy.
[*] Many players cited performance and optimization as something we should focus on. While we focused a lot on optimization for the NextFest build including introducing DLSS and FSR, we have more performance and optimization to go.
[*] Many players cited unfinished art and blockout areas in Greenwood (the level/map) — we will be finishing the map within the coming months![/list]
[h2]Class Design and Balance[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45046821/99c17958f9067068e0be0043b09b1c5c6f3b9be5.png[/img]
One of Legacy's core pillars of design is to bring the Ultimate Class Fantasy through our class design. We're happy to hear that players are enjoying the classes and we had tons of feedback about them.

[list]
[*] [b]🪓 Warrior: [/b]The Warrior continues to be ranked as powerful and fun in the survey, but many players cited challenges soloing PvE and general PvE survivability. We have some solutions in mind for this, including making his Block more effective for PvE. The Warrior also has a new Trait that we introduced called Wound Clot that is available at level 10 which lets the Warrior passively heal Wound damage (the "grey damage" that reduces max health).
[*] [b]🏹 Hunter:[/b] The Hunter continues to be a favorite playstyle, with many players—including likely many non-Hunters—praising the strength of the Longbow. We did a pass on the Longbow to bring it more in line while retaining its strength as a long-range sniper weapon. We also polished up the Shortbow and improved the Q (Tornado Volley), giving it a strong knockback effect.
[*] [b]🙏 Priest:[/b] Players mentioned the Priest, while fun, feels overloaded with strengths like flight (Ascend and Levitate), healing, and negating projectiles. We have toned down Gleaming Star's damage and are looking at Heaven's Fury to make it powerful but have more counterplay. (Tip: You'll always have time to Evade out of Heaven Fury before it hits — but if it does hit, it'll sting)
[*] [b]🗡️ Rogue: [/b]The Rogue is the most technical of the four classes currently in the game but players have mentioned it doesn't feel like you gain a lot in exchange, especially in PvE. We are taking a look at the Rogue's damage overall, and PvE in particular.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Alpha #3 Playtest Announcement[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45046821/190801b9ff19fd2dbcd51393882055f63dae8cd2.png[/img]
We are excited to announce our third Alpha Playtest which will happen on Wednesday, November 13th at 2 PM PST and end the following Wednesday, November 20th at 2 PM PST. See our Discord for details: http://discord.gg/playlegacy

We will do another post on Steam later with some detailed updates, but here's a preview:

[h3]The Lodge[/h3]
The Lodge is intended to be one of our core progression systems. Inside the Lodge you can unlock Furnishings that unlock bonuses and increased power. In this update, we've added the Cooking Pot, Bed, and Fireplace!
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45046821/611178404e01956bd637657e91196d8c7535d6a3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Cooking Pot -[/b]  You let us cook, now it's your time to cook. The Cooking feature in the Lodge lets you gather ingredients through the world and purchased from the vendors (like the Tavernmaid) to throw into your Cooking Pot within the lodge for buffs that persist through your Adventures. Increase your max Health, Stamina or even Poison Resist! Cooking buffs can persist for multiple Adventures (sessions) — if you find the right ingredients.
[*] [b]The Bed -[/b] Build your Bed to gain Rested Experience while offline. When you Adventure later that rested XP will give you a boost.
[*] [b]The Fireplace - [/b]The Fireplace is the critical Furnishing required to fuel all of the others. Simply add some Chopped Wood to the fireplace to fuel it.
[/list]
In addition to the Lodge, the patch will also features a lot of class balance and tuning, some new armor and weapon perks and adjustments, new art and sound — and more! 
[hr][/hr]
See you in Greenwood, and please remember to [b]Wishlist Legacy on Steam[/b] if you haven't already!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344320/Legacy_Steel__Sorcery/

[h3]Until next time -- 

Chris Kaleiki
Notorious Studios[/h3]

tags.feature: In this update, we've added the Cooking Pot, Bed, and Fireplace!

The Cooking feature in the Lodge lets you gather ingredients through the world and purchased from the vendors (like the Tavernmaid) to throw into your Cooking Pot within the lodge for buffs that persist through your Adventures.
Build your Bed to gain Rested Experience while offline.
The Fireplace is the critical Furnishing required to fuel all of the others.
